note: Security Deep Scan §12: every literal host in product code, reviewed (tooling/security/check-outbound-hosts.mjs). Categories: SERVER EGRESS (the API / worker calls it), BROWSER (an app page loads or calls it), LINK (rendered as a link / QR / store URL, never fetched by our code), OWN (our own origins), PLACEHOLDER / PARSE (form placeholder, URL-parsing base, in-memory seed — never contacted).
